ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   C. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

14. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)

   B. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
